title: Actress Eva Marie Saint, who won an Oscar for 'On the Waterfront,' dies at 102
content: Saint won an Oscar for her portrayal of Edie, a Catholic schoolgirl whose longshoreman brother is murdered. She went on to star in Alfred Hitchcock's North by Northwest.

title: Cornell names former acting U.S. attorney general to review rape case
content: Cornell University names Sally Yates, former acting U.S. attorney general and career federal prosecutor, to lead an independent review into how the school handled a former student's rape allegations.

title: France's police fire tear gas and water cannons as school protests sweep the country
content: More than a quarter of a million people rallied nationwide to support school students demanding more education funding, according to government figures, with thousands of arrests.

title: Here are the finalists for the 2026 National Book Awards
content: Three-time National Book Award finalist Edwidge Danticat and debut novelist Morgan Thomas are up for the fiction prize. Nonfiction books cover the prison system and music, and queer parenthood.

title: What to know about nationwide protests in India over voter list changes
content: The campaign is led in part by India's "Cockroach" youth movement, which previously forced the education minister to resign.

title: Vietnamese police arrest 12 suspected of prowling city streets at night, snatching cats for meat
content: State media cited investigators who said the network recruited people to ride motorcycles through neighborhoods at night, trapping up to 10 cats a night.

title: Ex-spy chief is arrested in Germany on suspicion of trading state secrets and treason
content: A former head of Germany 's foreign intelligence service was arrested on suspicion that he had passed state secrets to a foreign intelligence service, the federal prosecutor's office said.

title: Dems have edge in midterms, poll shows. And, Paramount-Warner Bros. merger to close
content: Polls are showing that Democrats have a clear advantage heading into the midterms, but that doesn't tell the whole story. And, today, a mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros. is set to close.

title: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
content: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

title: A history of presidents naming things after themselves (It's short. They rarely do)
content: While Trump pushes to get his name on the Kennedy Center and other public sites, history shows that sitting presidents have almost always avoided putting their brands on government assets.
